raw.description: 自身受到技能伤害后，对手3回合内攻击免疫效果失效|回合开始时，自身防御、特防+1；战斗阶段结束时，若自身处于能力提升状态，则将防御、特防能力等级转化为攻击、特攻能力等级，然后自身每有1组攻击、特攻能力提升等级，自身恢复最大体力的17%，下回合造成的攻击伤害提升17%|（boss有效）
raw.analyze_desc: [sprite name=dot1]自身受到技能伤害后，[color=#52a5f2]对手[/color]3回合内攻击[color=#57c975]免疫[/color]效果失效|[sprite name=dot1][color=#52a5f2]回合开始[/color]时，自身防御、特防+1；[color=#57c975]战斗阶段结束时[/color]，若自身处于[color=#52a5f2]能力提升状态[/color]，则将防御、特防能力等级[color=#52a5f2]转化[/color]为攻击、特攻能力等级，[color=#52a5f2]然后[/color]自身每有1[color=#52a5f2]组[/color]攻击、特攻能力提升等级，自身恢复最大体力的17%，下回合造成的攻击伤害提升17%

review.rationale: 转换叠加与限制、正负源范围均已答，源正级消耗、六级上限与回复组数实际状态验证。
review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.singleBehavior: 回合初双防+1；战阶若有正级，仅正防转对应双攻并清零原正防，叠加已存双攻并钳六级，负防保留，禁强化不阻转化；按实际正双攻组数回复当前最大HP17%并下回红增幅。受到正数技能红使敌当前起3回免攻失效；免伤次数不消耗。

success.name: 4909真实2096回合开始双防各一，明确零目标等级转化消耗原单位，组数取正双攻较小值并回复17%
success.assertion: test('4909真实2096回合开始双防各一，明确零目标等级转化消耗原单位，组数取正双攻较小值并回复17%',()=>{for(const[def,spd,groups]of[[0,0,1],[1,2,2],[2,0,1],[-1,-1,0]]){const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:1000});s.fighters[0].stages.def=def;s.fighters[0].stages.spd=spd;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.def,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spd,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,def+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spa,spd+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.puppet4909.groups,groups);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+1530*groups);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['钢傀双攻组红伤增幅']?.fraction??0,.17*groups);if(groups===0)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['钢傀双攻组红伤增幅'],undefined);}});

success.name: 4909真实2096按当前最大HP回复、技能禁疗不封锁魂印，普通回复削减及满体上限照常
success.assertion: test('4909真实2096按当前最大HP回复、技能禁疗不封锁魂印，普通回复削减及满体上限照常',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','ban','cut','full']){const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:mode==='full'?9000:1000});if(mode==='ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='cut')timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='full'?9000:mode==='cut'?1765:2530);}const changed=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:1000});changed.fighters[0].stats.maxHp=10000;turn(changed,10086,20309);assert.equal(changed.fighters[0].hp,2700);});

success.name: 4909真实2096受到正数完整技能红伤才敌当前起3回免攻失效，次数不消费、到期恢复且固定/零红不触发
success.assertion: test('4909真实2096受到正数完整技能红伤才敌当前起3回免攻失效，次数不消费、到期恢复且固定/零红不触发',()=>{for(const type of['timed','count']){const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,aStats:{spe:50},hp:1000});if(type==='timed')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');else s.fighters[1].counts.attackNullify=2;turn(s,10086,10127);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['钢傀攻击免疫失效'].start,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['钢傀攻击免疫失效'].end,3);if(type==='count')assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.attackNullify,2);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.clearBoost(c.a);},()=>{for(let r=2;r<=4;r++){turn(s,10086,20309);assert.equal(sum(s)>0,r<=3);}});if(type==='count')assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.attackNullify,1);}const zero=make({move:10086,soul:true});timer(zero,0,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(zero,10086,10127);assert.equal(zero.fighters[1].effects['钢傀攻击免疫失效'],undefined);const fixed=make({move:10086,soul:true});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,100,'隔离已知固定伤害','fixed');},()=>turn(fixed,10086,20309));assert.equal(fixed.fighters[1].effects['钢傀攻击免疫失效'],undefined);});

success.name: 4909真实2096下一回红伤提升17%不是固定真伤增幅，先消除自身强化可独立验证到期且不猜非零目标转化
success.assertion: test('4909真实2096下一回红伤提升17%不是固定真伤增幅，先消除自身强化可独立验证到期且不猜非零目标转化',()=>{const a=make({move:10086,soul:true}),b=make({move:10086,soul:true});turn(a,10086,20309);turn(b,10086,20309);delete b.fighters[0].effects['钢傀双攻组红伤增幅'];const clear=(e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.clearBoost(c.t);};observe(clear,()=>{turn(a,10086,20309);turn(b,10086,20309);});assert.ok(sum(a)>=Math.floor(sum(b)*1.17));assert.ok(sum(a)<=Math.ceil(sum(b)*1.17));observe(clear,()=>{turn(a,10086,20309);turn(b,10086,20309);});assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));});

success.name: 4909真实2096已有非零目标叠加正防、负防保留、禁强化不阻止直接转化
success.assertion: test('4909真实2096已有非零目标叠加正防、负防保留、禁强化不阻止直接转化',()=>{for(const mode of['positive','negativeTarget','negativeSource','forbid']){const s=make({move:10086,soul:true});if(mode==='positive')s.fighters[0].stages.atk=1;if(mode==='negativeTarget')s.fighters[0].stages.atk=-1;if(mode==='negativeSource'){s.fighters[0].stages.def=-2;s.fighters[0].stages.spe=1;}if(mode==='forbid'){timer(s,0,'禁强化');s.fighters[0].stages.def=2;s.fighters[0].stages.spe=1;}turn(s,10086,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.puppet4909.events.length,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,mode==='positive'||mode==='forbid'?2:mode==='negativeTarget'?0:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.def,mode==='negativeSource'?-1:0);if(mode==='forbid')assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spa,0);}});

success.name: 4909全部17招有序编译与64种子真实基础状态，2096原生17招正防叠加转化真实验证
success.assertion: test('4909全部17招有序编译与64种子真实基础状态，2096原生17招正防叠加转化真实验证',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.puppet4909.events.length,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.puppet4909.events[0].after.def,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.puppet4909.events[0].after.spd,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.def,m.id===29365?2:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spd,m.id===29365?2:0);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}});

success.name: 4909已答正防转化叠加现有双攻并消耗正防，负防原样保留、禁强化不阻转化，六级上限及实际正双攻组数回复
success.assertion: test('4909已答正防转化叠加现有双攻并消耗正防，负防原样保留、禁强化不阻转化，六级上限及实际正双攻组数回复',()=>{for(const mode of['positive','negative-target','negative-source','forbid','caps']){const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:1000});Object.assign(s.fighters[0].stages,{def:2,spd:3,atk:1,spa:2,spe:1});if(mode==='negative-target')Object.assign(s.fighters[0].stages,{atk:-4,spa:-5});if(mode==='negative-source')Object.assign(s.fighters[0].stages,{def:-4,spd:-3});if(mode==='forbid')timer(s,0,'禁强化');if(mode==='caps')Object.assign(s.fighters[0].stages,{def:5,spd:5,atk:5,spa:5});let before;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='combatEnd'&&c.a.side===0)before={...c.a.stages};},()=>turn(s,10086,20309),true);const after=s.fighters[0].stages;for(const [from,to]of[['def','atk'],['spd','spa']]){assert.equal(after[from],before[from]>0?0:before[from]);assert.equal(after[to],before[from]>0?Math.min(6,before[to]+before[from]):before[to]);}const groups=Math.min(Math.max(0,after.atk),Math.max(0,after.spa));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.puppet4909.groups,groups);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,Math.min(9000,1000+Math.floor(9000*.17*groups)));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.puppet4909.events.length,1);if(mode==='negative-source'){assert.ok(after.def<0&&after.spd<0);assert.equal(after.atk,1);assert.equal(after.spa,2);}if(mode==='forbid'){assert.equal(before.def,2);assert.equal(after.atk,3);}}});

success.name: 4909/715次回合第一次命中才随机两项各减2、当前回不触发、到期不触发、免弱与零红受攻按API466
success.assertion: test('4909/715次回合第一次命中才随机两项各减2、当前回不触发、到期不触发、免弱与零红受攻按API466',()=>{for(const mode of['hit','immune','zero','miss','control']){const s=make({...row(715),loadout:[27321,10086,29365,29366,38414]});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.ok(Object.values(s.fighters[1].stages).every(v=>v===0));if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'免弱');if(mode==='zero')timer(s,0,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='miss'){delete s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,0,'概率闪避',{chance:100});}if(mode==='control')s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=s.round;turn(s,10086,10127);assert.equal(Object.values(s.fighters[1].stages).filter(v=>v===-2).length,['hit','zero'].includes(mode)?2:0);assert.ok(Object.values(s.fighters[1].stages).every(v=>v===0||v===-2));const before={...s.fighters[1].stages};turn(s,10086,10127);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[1].stages,before);}});

success.assertion: test('4909/715同回合第二完整技能独立随机两弱化，多段同招只触发一次并保留旧4264范围',()=>{const s=make({...row(715),loadout:[27321,10086,29365,29366,38414]});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);const old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;let replayed=false;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(phase,ops,c){const out=old.run(phase,ops,c);if(phase==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===1&&!replayed){replayed=true;c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10127)));}return out;}};try{turn(s,10086,10127);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}assert.equal(s.round,3);assert.equal(Object.values(s.fighters[1].stages).reduce((n,v)=>n-v,0),8);assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.sourceSide===1&&e.type==='attack').length,2);});

success.name: 4909已答715每完整技能反制：原生多段一次、额外技能另一次、命中零红仍反制，免弱失败不补抽且独立旧实例不改
success.assertion: test('4909已答715每完整技能反制：原生多段一次、额外技能另一次、命中零红仍反制，免弱失败不补抽且独立旧实例不改',()=>{for(const mode of['native','extra','zero','immune']){const s=make({...row(715),loadout:[27321,10086,29365,29366,38414],enemyLoadout:[10713,10127,10716,20309,37911]});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);if(mode==='zero')timer(s,0,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'免弱');const old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;let replayed=false;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const out=old.run(p,o,c);if(mode==='extra'&&p==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===1&&!replayed){replayed=true;c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10127)));}return out;}};try{turn(s,10086,10713);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}const total=Object.values(s.fighters[1].stages).reduce((n,v)=>n-v,0);assert.equal(total,mode==='immune'?0:mode==='extra'?8:4);if(mode!=='zero')assert.ok(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.sourceSide===1&&e.type==='attack').length>=2);else assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.counter7154909.round,2);const levels={...s.fighters[1].stages};turn(s,10086,10127);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[1].stages,levels);}});

success.assertion: test('4909/893满体全二否则全一、885严格高于敌体才全二，776下两回红伤双倍、843所有技能先制2到期',()=>{for(const id of[893,885])for(const hp of[8999,9000]){const s=make({...row(id),hp,targetHp:id===885?8999:9000});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages[k],hp===9000?2:1);}for(const id of[776,843]){const a=make({...row(id),loadout:[29366,27323,10086,29365,38414]}),b=make({...row(id),index:-1,loadout:[29366,27323,10086,29365,38414]});turn(a,a.auditMoveId,20309);turn(b,b.auditMoveId,20309);for(let r=2;r<=4;r++){turn(a,10086,20309);turn(b,10086,20309);if(id===843)assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,r<=3?2:0);else if(r<=3){assert.ok(sum(a)>=sum(b)*2-1);assert.ok(sum(a)<=sum(b)*2+1);}else assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));}}});

success.assertion: test('4909/791与1067当次及后续实际用招回复，比较体力严格低敌翻倍，低半体百分比吸取理论回复含免疫',()=>{for(const hp of[1000,4499,4500,9000]){const s=make({...row(791),hp});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,Math.min(9000,hp+(hp<9000?6000:3000)));}for(const mode of['low','boundary','immune','overkill','ban']){const s=make({...row(1067),hp:mode==='boundary'?4500:1000,targetHp:mode==='overkill'?200:9000});if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='boundary'||mode==='immune'?0:3000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='ban'?1000:mode==='boundary'?7500:4000);}});

success.assertion: test('4909/893满体全二否则全一、885严格高于敌体才全二，776下两回红伤双倍、843所有技能先制2到期',()=>{for(const id of[893,885])for(const hp of[8999,9000]){const s=make({...row(id),hp,targetHp:id===885?8999:9000});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages[k],hp===9000?2:1);}for(const id of[776,843]){const a=make({...row(id),loadout:[29366,27323,10086,29365,38414]}),b=make({...row(id),index:-1,loadout:[29366,27323,10086,29365,38414]});turn(a,a.auditMoveId,20309);turn(b,b.auditMoveId,20309);for(let r=2;r<=4;r++){turn(a,10086,20309);turn(b,10086,20309);if(id===843)assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,r<=3?2:0);else if(r<=3){assert.ok(sum(a)>=sum(b)*2-1);assert.ok(sum(a)<=sum(b)*2+1);}else assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));}}});

success.assertion: test('4909/791与1067当次及后续实际用招回复，比较体力严格低敌翻倍，低半体百分比吸取理论回复含免疫',()=>{for(const hp of[1000,4499,4500,9000]){const s=make({...row(791),hp});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,Math.min(9000,hp+(hp<9000?6000:3000)));}for(const mode of['low','boundary','immune','overkill','ban']){const s=make({...row(1067),hp:mode==='boundary'?4500:1000,targetHp:mode==='overkill'?200:9000});if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='boundary'||mode==='immune'?0:3000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='ban'?1000:mode==='boundary'?7500:4000);}});

success.assertion: test('4909/791与1067已授回复MISS和整招无效仍执行，控制/药剂不执行且四回合到期',()=>{for(const id of[791,1067])for(const mode of['invalid','miss','control','potion']){const s=make({...row(id),hp:1000,loadout:[29366,27323,10086,29365,38414]});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);s.fighters[0].hp=1000;if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=s.round;if(mode==='miss'){delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});}turn(s,mode==='potion'?null:10086,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='potion'?1250:mode==='control'?1000:id===791?7000:4000);}for(const id of[791,1067]){const s=make({...row(id),hp:1000,loadout:[29366,27323,10086,29365,38414]});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);for(let r=2;r<=4;r++){s.fighters[0].hp=1000;turn(s,10086,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,id===791?7000:4000);}s.fighters[0].hp=1000;turn(s,10086,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000);}});
